mapper.sql: select version_id, doc_id, doc_no, version_no, file_url, change_log, version_status, publish_by, publish_time, obsolete_by, obsolete_time, esig_user, esig_meaning, esig_time, create_by, create_time, remark from qms_doc_version
mapper.select: where doc_id = #{docId} order by version_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into qms_doc_version(doc_id, doc_no, version_no, file_url, change_log, version_status, publish_by, publish_time, esig_user, esig_meaning, esig_time, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{docId}, #{docNo}, #{versionNo}, #{fileUrl}, #{changeLog}, #{versionStatus}, #{publishBy}, sysdate(), #{esigUser}, #{esigMeaning}, sysdate(), #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from qms_doc_version where version_id in #{versionId}
